subject: Re: 🔵{Brand} & MobUpps
body:
Hi RECIPIENT_NAME,
Following up on my earlier email about paid-subscription acquisition for {Brand} in the UK. One angle I did not stress: the trial mechanic is the deciding lever, since opt-out card-on-file trials convert at 48.8 percent against 18.2 percent for opt-in trials with no card (adapty 2026). The supply you put against the trial sits across that band, and that gap is where billing-event screening and incrementality set your real cost per validated payer. We hold out a control group so paid subscriptions read as incremental to your organic converters. Worth a quick comparison?
angle: fresh angle: trial-mechanic lever (opt-out vs opt-in card-on-file) + sourced trial-conversion band
register_notes: Stage 2 EN subscription_media CPS: acknowledges the second follow-up and references the prior email in the first sentence; fresh angle = the trial mechanic as the deciding lever, anchored to a real, web-verified trial-conversion band (opt-out card-on-file 48.8 percent vs opt-in no-card 18.2 percent, adapty 2026, URL in enrichment_sources, inherited from the parent's verified sources); MobUpps holdout/incrementality referenced with no figure (no illustrative flag this stage); exactly 1 question mark; native British English, no transliteration; no sign-off; no em dash, no curly quotes, no X-not-Y comma-negation (stated positively).
